questions.q: EITHER (a) How does Shakespeare present guilt in Macbeth? OR (b) How does Shakespeare present Lady Macbeth as a powerful character?
questions.a: AO1 10, AO2 10, AO4 10. (a) The dagger soliloquy (2.1); 'Will all great Neptune's ocean wash this blood' (2.2); Banquo's ghost (3.4); the sleepwalking scene (5.1); Jacobean belief in conscience and damnation. (b) Her soliloquy in 1.5; her persuasion in 1.7; control after the murder; her decline; expectations of women in Jacobean England.
